constraints.name: work_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state = 'leased'::text) = ((lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (expires_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: work_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state = 'leased'::text) OR ((lease_token IS NULL) AND (expires_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: work_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: work_turn_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (turn_id) REFERENCES public.turns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
